Scale: the plate is about 26 cm across in the image, which spans roughly 630 px, so about 24 px per cm.

The pear (an Asian or golden pear) is about 275 px wide, or roughly 11 cm. A round fruit that size weighs about 450 g at the most, but its visible height is probably also about 10 cm. A sphere of 10.5 cm diameter has a volume of about 600 cm³, which at a density of about 0.85 g/cm³ gives roughly 480 g. A pear of that size more likely weighs 350 g, so I'll use that.

The apple is about 165 px across, or roughly 7 cm. It is partly hidden behind the pear. A 7 cm apple weighs about 150 g.
